user.title: Set up iGro
user.description: Configure your plant grow cycle manager. iGro stores grow data in a dedicated SQLite database inside your Home Assistant config folder.

data.db_path: SQLite database path (relative to /config or absolute)
data.media_path: Photo storage folder (relative to /config or absolute)
data.leaf_temp_offset_c: Default leaf temperature offset (°C for VPD)
